counties: Riverside County and San Bernardino County, California (the 1838 Mexican grant spanned both banks of the Santa Ana River; Riverside County was not created until 1893, so early records place it in San Bernardino / Los Angeles district). Owner families: Bandini, (Robidoux/Rubidoux), Stearns.
disambiguation_notes: This Rancho Jurupa is in Riverside/San Bernardino County. It is unrelated to any San Diego rancho and unrelated to the modern city of Rancho Santa Margarita in Orange County.

Louis (Louis F.) Robidoux / Rubidoux of Rancho Jurupa is a DIFFERENT person from Antoine Robidoux, the fur trapper whose 'Robidoux inscription' at Westwater Canyon (Utah/Colorado) dominates keyword searches. Those inscription items were excluded as false positives.

Abel Stearns married Juan Bandini's daughter Arcadia; Stearns acquired Rancho Jurupa and the U.S. patent was issued to Stearns in 1879. Hence the Bandini, Robidoux, and Stearns names all attach to this one grant.
